// 1. 跳过指定类不做处理
Lcom.example.main/entry/ets/entryability/EntryAbility;

// 2. 跳过包下所有类不做处理
Lcom.example.main/entry/ets/entryability

// 3. 跳过指定类和包下所有类不做处理
Lcom.example.main/entry/ets/entryability/EntryAbility;
Lcom.example.main/entry/ets/entryability
